notes: Fixes the Market hard-freeze caused by the weapon-description MutationObserver rewriting already-correct weapon cards on every observer pass.

Market weapon-card synchronization is now idempotent using a content signature and requestAnimationFrame scheduling, so rerenders update only changed cards and the observer settles instead of recursively mutating forever.

Removes the visible empty black strip beneath FEHA weapon sheets by trimming the outer Foundry window against the actual rendered FEHA page bottom rather than using approximate header/scroll-height math.
Weapon Sheet advances to 1.6.1 and Market Stock Patch advances to 1.5.1.
No Market stock, prices, weapon balance, DEX rules, reload cadence, armor, cyberware, grenade, or Quickhack rules changed.
